miners.name: FactWire Document Authenticity
miners.description: Authenticity assessment for a described document, produced by a language model at request time. Send the document or the whole question and the miner returns a verdict (likely authentic, likely forged, likely altered or uncertain) with one or two sentences naming the deciding features, for example inconsistent fonts, mismatched metadata or dates, an altered total, an invalid seal or a hash that does not match a published checksum, then states that this is an assessment of the described features rather than a forensic certification. The answer is produced with MiniMax under a commercial plan held by the operator, so this miner is not keyless. Serves the DOCUMENT_AUTHENTICITY intent.

miners.description: Deterministic infrastructure and on-chain signals for autonomous systems, each read live at question time. Prices, TVL, FX, geolocation, papers and CVEs come from named public sources, cited in each answer.

miners.name: ZK Exact Public Document Copy Verification
miners.description: Model-free document provenance with an exact-copy RFC text check. A JSON document string containing an official RFC text url and complete text is compared byte-for-byte as UTF-8 against fetched RFC Editor bytes and checked against separately fetched IETF Datatracker identity/title. Supports official RFC identifiers/URLs, PLOS article pages, GPO Federal Register HTML and bounded quoted-title discovery. Only matching, corroborated public references or supplied RFC copies receive Likely authentic. Source disagreement, unknown copies and digest/text mismatches remain Inconclusive. Does not certify signatures, authorship, scientific accuracy or legal effect.
